links.outcome: ASR word error rate on older Dutch adults' speech, generic versus fine-tuned models
links.effect: Generic multilingual models outperformed models fine-tuned for older Dutch adults' speech, so they generalise well out of the box. Some inputs still caused a high word error rate.
links.quote: Our results show that generic multilingual models outperform fine-tuned models, which suggests recent ASR models can generalise well out of the box to real-world datasets.

unlisted_practices: Fine-tuning ASR models on older-adult speech
Truncating generic ASR models to balance accuracy and processing speed

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy and speed of various ASR models on real recorded interactions of older Dutch adults with a geriatric chatbot, benchmarking off-the-shelf vs fine-tuned models.
